svg.text: Illustration: typical DOL pump starter panel with monitor connections
Simplified. Device order is a typical arrangement for the parts named in this repository, not a copy of any company drawing.
V1, V2, V3 | ZMPT101B, phase to neutral | ESP32 ADC GPIO35 / 32 / 33
I1, I2, I3 | SCT-013 100 A / 50 mA, 33 ohm burden + bias | ADS1115 AIN0 / 1 / 2, I2C 0x48
Supply: fused 5 V rail (prototype: 1 A fuse on an ATX 5 V rail)
Protection logic, OLED (I2C 0x3C), red / yellow / green LEDs, manual reset button GPIO26
Contact COM-NO is in series with the K1 coil in the control circuit (blue contact above).
Trip or loss of power = contact opens, K1 drops out, manual reset needed.
ILLUSTRATION ONLY. Not a Jahan Pump document.
Simplified and typical. Ratings shown are those named in this repository's documents.
CT and voltage tap positions are illustrative; final positions are documented in docs/hardware.md.
